company.name: Svbtle
company.shortDescription: Svbtle, an invite-only blogging platform, combines traditional publishing and the internet to enable people to share and discover new ideas.
company.description:
Svbtle is publishing network that brings some of the best things from newspapers and magazines to a network of great people. They focus on the people, the writing, and the ideas. Everything else is secondary. 

Svbtle's goal is to make it easier and more natural for interesting people to write down their thoughts. In the process, they also hope to help their members become better writers. To accomplish these goals, they provide benefits that aren’t usually associated with blogging, like copyediting and fact-checking, to all members, for free.
